title: EXPLORE ONGOING SUPPORT OR COACHING WITH CHATGPT
content:
Ongoing support or coaching can be sold as a subscription when customers receive continuing help rather than a single completed service.

The recurring value may be access, feedback, accountability, troubleshooting, planning, review, implementation support, or another form of assistance that remains useful over time.

YOUR TIME MAY BE THE CAPACITY LIMIT
If every subscriber receives direct access to you, the subscription can become more demanding as it succeeds. That is not automatically bad. It simply means capacity and boundaries are part of the product design.

DEFINE THE ACCESS
"Ongoing support" can mean very different things: one scheduled call each month, asynchronous questions, office hours, group coaching, reviews, messaging access, or combinations. Clear boundaries protect both the customer experience and your workload.

DO NOT CONFUSE RECURRING BILLING WITH PERMANENT NEED
Ask why customers need support over time and what would make them appropriately graduate or cancel. A healthy model does not require manufacturing dependence just to preserve revenue.

COPY & PASTE INTO CHATGPT

Interview me about an ongoing support or coaching subscription. Ask who I would help, what recurring problem or progress they need support with, what expertise I can legitimately provide, what kind of access I want to offer, how many customers I could support, boundaries, response expectations, group versus individual delivery, and what success or graduation might look like.

Help me design a realistic service shape without pretending I have credentials I do not have. Flag professional licensing, scope-of-practice, safety, privacy, recordkeeping, insurance, or other requirements for independent verification when relevant to the subject matter.

At the end give me:
- Intended customer
- Ongoing support need
- Delivery/access model
- Frequency and boundaries
- Capacity constraints
- What success or graduation looks like
- Professional or operational questions to verify
- Concise business-direction statement

WHERE TO GO NEXT
If clear, continue to PDF 46. If the amount of direct labor concerns you, PDF 45 can help explore making a service less dependent on your time.
